verdict.rationale: Datadog has a dedicated first-party documentation section, "OpenTelemetry in Datadog", and a customer reports instrumenting Elixir apps with OTel and sending the data into Datadog. That is hands-on evidence that OTel telemetry reaches the platform. missing for 10: explicit evidence of direct OTLP ingestion endpoints (vs. routing through the Agent/Collector), detail on which signals (traces/metrics/logs) are supported over OTLP, in-depth doc content beyond the page title.
